description: This file contains utility functions for image processing, including augmentation, bounding box correction, and image scaling. It appears to be part of an object detection pipeline, providing core image manipulation routines.

methods.name: _rand_scale(scale)
methods.description: Generates a random scale factor within a specified range, randomly inverted.

methods.name: _constrain(min_v, max_v, value)
methods.description: Constrains a value within specified minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: random_flip(image, flip)
methods.description: Flips the image horizontally if flip equals 1.

methods.name: correct_bounding_boxes(boxes, new_w, new_h, net_w, net_h, dx, dy, flip, image_w, image_h)
methods.description: Adjusts bounding box coordinates based on image transformations such as scaling, shifting, and flipping, removing invalid boxes.

methods.name: random_distort_image(image, hue=18, saturation=1.5, exposure=1.5)
methods.description: Applies random distortions to the image's hue, saturation, and exposure for data augmentation.

methods.name: apply_random_scale_and_crop(image, new_w, new_h, net_w, net_h, dx, dy)
methods.description: Resizes and pads/crops the image to fit specified dimensions, maintaining aspect ratio and accommodating shifts.
